items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: And so one of them, Brian, said, to me, “Peter, what happened to your accent?

ctx.x: You know it’s funny that you say this because where I come from their dialect or whatever you could call it, accent, is very broad. Like for instance if I’d grown up around there I’m sure I would have adopted it. I go back and I can hear my accent slipping into that way of speaking. And it’s funny you know, about four years ago I went back and I invited my four cousins to come to see me play. They’d never seen me play. And so one of them, Brian, said, to me, “Peter, what happened to your accent? You don’t talk…
He said you were talking what?
